pages_detail.activities: Cut out 4 triangles and 2 squares, paste them together to build a big square (from the triangles) and a big rectangle (from the squares), then finish four sentences using sides and corners language.
answers: Build 1: 4 triangles make a square. The square has 4 sides and 4 corners.
Build 2: 2 squares make a rectangle. The rectangle has 4 sides and 4 corners.
Background vocabulary: a triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.
